en: Black‑and‑white view of a landscaped garden or park. In the foreground is a large tree with a circular bench around its base on the left and a woman in an elegant long dress and wide‑brimmed hat standing on a path at the right. The middle ground shows rectangular garden beds bordered by low hedges. In the background stands a small pavilion with a tiled hipped roof supported by four columns, surrounded by trees. A larger building with a steep gable roof is faintly visible through the trees on the left. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.
